title: Product list (current codes)
summary: Current product catalogue for the Valdena Gelato shop: 64 products with their post-2024 codes, names and categories. It is a static lookup table refreshed on change. The wiki (product_codes_2024) explicitly confirms there is no mapping between the old and new codes — codes ending in 'L' were replaced from 2024-04-01, and matching can only be done by product name, where some names are not unique. For N2 (code mapping) this source covers only the current side of the mapping and must be matched by name against older records. For N1 (daily sales) it provides the product catalogue that references the product_code column in sales.daily_by_product.

schema.notes: Only 3 columns; no old (pre-2024) product codes are stored in this table.

spatial.notes: Valdena is a fictional Italian gelato shop; products are national/regional Italian product codes; no explicit geography in the data.
